newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia tenders 350 million birr in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia tenders 350 million birr in T-bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) on Thursday tendered for sale treasury bills valued at 350 million birr ($55.1 million).
The bills are for the 28-day, 91-day and 182-day categories and are to be issued on March 12, 1997.

The amounts tendered were 175 million birr for 28-day bills maturing on April 9, 100 million birr for 91-day bills maturing on June 11 and 75 million birr for 182-day bills maturing on September 10. The bank said it sold 325 million birr 28-day catagory treasury bills it offered on Feburary 26.
The weighted average price for 100 birr was 99.750 and the weighted rate 3.27 percent, the bank said. ($ = 6.351 Ethiopian Birr)
